overview: The Icon Button is a generic icon-only button component. It renders a button (or optionally an anchor) containing a single Lucide icon, and supports multiple color variants to convey different action intents. A square modifier removes horizontal padding and applies a circular border radius for a compact, symmetrical appearance. Use this component when an action needs to be represented by an icon without accompanying text.

whenToUse: When an interactive action can be clearly represented by a recognized icon glyph in a space-constrained context
When a compact circular or pill-shaped button is needed alongside other elements such as in toolbars or card headers
do: Always provide an aria-label attribute so screen readers can announce the button's purpose — without it the button has no accessible name
Choose the variant that reflects the action's intent — use destructive for delete actions, branded for primary brand-colored actions
dont: Don't place more than one icon or text inside the button — it should contain a single icon only
Don't use Icon Button when a text label can fit — labeled buttons communicate intent more clearly and require less cognitive load
